# Team rules for Copilot

These rules apply to every chat in this folder.

- Write in English. Use short sentences and simple words.
- Keep existing IDs. Requirements use REQ-###. User stories use US-###.
- User story format: As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>.
- Acceptance criteria format: Given / When / Then.
- Do not invent business facts. If information is missing, ask a question.
- Write new files only in the `output/` folder.
